title: Host-signed delegation envelopes: issue, admit, replay ledger and revocation
goal: Make the recursion adapter's cross-process envelope unforgeable: only a DelegationAuthority keyed from the host's shared MAC key issues or admits susi-delegation/v1 envelopes (HMAC-SHA256, random id, absolute expiry <= 1 h); tampered, unsigned, expired or foreign-host envelopes are refused; replays in one process continue one level (shared budget and fan-out); revocation cancels a level and its descendants; os_capabilities and the CLI gain a delegate action that issues envelopes under the same bounds.
capabilities: MacPolicy::derive_key (purpose-separated keys from the shared host MAC key)
CapabilityRegistry::issue_delegation and serve_nested; dispatch_nested admits only signed envelopes
os_capabilities action `delegate`; susi os capabilities delegate
acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-core --lib -- delegation capability_bus registry
cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-gmcp --test os_capabilities_delegation (three child processes on scratch SUSI_HOME)
cargo clippy --offline --locked -p susi --bin susi -p susi-core -p susi-gmcp -p susi-cli-defs --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test socket_parity --test lean_core_ceilings --test architecture_tests --test capability_bus --test task_records --test gmcp_requirements
susi binary smoke: delegate/nested delegate/invoke/tampered/foreign-home across separate processes
host: Claude Code cloud session, Linux x86_64, 4 vCPU, 15 GiB RAM, Rust 1.99.0 (pinned), Git 2.43.0

results.susi_core_lib: 487/487 passed; 44 focused (delegation|capability_bus|registry), of which 8 new signed-envelope tests replace 2 unsigned ones
results.susi_gmcp: lib 213/213, main 5/5, tests/os_capabilities_delegation 1/1 (parent + 3 child processes on scratch SUSI_HOME: issue, admit, foreign refusal), tests/tool_input_schemas 4/4
results.gmcp_requirements: 87/87 after re-recording requirement (54 checks) and mastery (9 checks) evidence
results.root_governance: architecture_tests 43/43, lean_core_ceilings 2/2 (susi-gmcp exactly 25,900), socket_parity 5/5, capability_bus 5/5, task_records 3/3
results.clippy: clean with -D warnings: susi binary, susi-core, susi-gmcp, susi-cli-defs (--all-targets)
results.binary_smoke: target/debug/susi in separate processes on a scratch SUSI_HOME: delegate issued; nested delegate with budget 101 > 100 refused BudgetExceeded; budget 40 issued; invoke with it admitted (then UnknownCapability: a bare CLI registers no tools); tampered budget refused Unverified; different SUSI_HOME refused Unverified; host key created only in the scratch home

limitations: Any process holding the host key is trusted to issue; an envelope is bound to the host key, not to the caller or transport presenting it.
Replay ledger and revocation are per process; two admitting processes each start from the full budget. revoke has no socket or CLI action yet.
Envelopes do not cross hosts (another host's key refuses them); a cluster-key variant is future work.
Only capability dispatch opens scopes; harness missions, GEMI worker delegation and GAWD swarm hand-offs are not wired yet.
Not run on native Windows x86_64 in this session.
